crossRefs.note: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
They don’t know, neither do they consider: for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see; and their hearts, that they…
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has…
He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”
Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father…
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
Take me away with you. Let’s hurry. The king has brought me into his rooms. We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will…
Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with…
I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks…
This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him…
This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life…

translations.web: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.
translations.bsb: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
translations.kjv: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
translations.asv: No man can come to me, except the Father that sent me draw him: and I will raise him up in the last day.
